mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% consistently reduces the risk-free rate, compressing equity discount rates and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 5.5% for two consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises above 5.5% for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 5.5% for 2 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates broad-based consumer demand contraction, triggering negative earnings expectations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative returns in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.05 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 100 signals manufacturing output contraction, reducing corporate profitability and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Non-farm payroll growth above 100,000 per month signals strong labor market conditions, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS > 100,000, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Core CPI inflation above 2.5% annually signals accelerating inflation, prompting monetary tightening and reducing equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 2.5% annually, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of CPI inflation above 2.5% and federal funds rate above 0.5% signals an impending monetary tightening cycle, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition of CPIAUCSL > 2.5% and FEDFUNDS > 0.5% fails to predict negative returns in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.05 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Real GDP growth below 1.0% annually signals economic slowdown, reducing corporate earnings growth and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when GDPC1 annualized growth rate < 1.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.05.
